candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing at the order call with 500, while order /healthz and postgres.ready succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the order 500 (code defect vs dependency) is not established; order logs/metrics were excluded.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently caused by order service 500 responses on POST /v1/orders across all traced correlation IDs. Gateway metrics confirm 502s on /v1/checkout. The order service is reachable (healthz 200, postgres.ready ok), so the failure is an application-level 500 rather than connectivity. The specific internal cause of the order 500 is not yet evidenced.
missing_evidence: Order service logs for the failing POST /v1/orders requests to identify the 500 exception
Order service metrics (error rate, latency, dependency outcomes) during the incident window
